author: wanawachee
body:
Just set one up. No matter where you are, you can always warp back at the press of a button. You may need to build something though. 
I live about an hour from my origin town, and only return physically a few times a year. 
It won't matter for gameplay. 

Watch your speed, Casey Jones

author: theslashveto
body: In addition to the comment u/wanawachee made about it being easy to visit your origin town frequently, you can also move it every 3 days, so if you do need to move it so you can actually be there for something, (building something or opening your portal for multiplayer) you can always move your ot for free
